bio: Hi, I'm Camille, a data professional with 6+ years of experience turning complex, messy data into decisions that actually move businesses forward. I specialize in data engineering, analytics engineering, machine learning, and automation, building everything from end-to-end pipelines to AI-driven solutions that eliminate inefficiencies and surface insights that matter. I bring a rare combination of technical depth and finance domain expertise, which means I don't just build data solutions. I understand the business problems behind them.

specializations.title: Building Data Infrastructure That Scales
specializations.description: I design and maintain end-to-end data pipelines from ingestion and transformation to modeling and visualization so data is always accurate, accessible, and ready to use.

specializations.title: Turning Data Into Decisions
specializations.description: I transform raw, complex data into clear, actionable insights through dashboards, automated reporting, and analytics workflows that help businesses move faster and smarter.

specializations.title: Automating What Slows You Down
specializations.description: I build Python and Google Apps Script-based automation solutions that eliminate repetitive manual processes, reducing hours of work to minutes with measurable efficiency gains of up to 95%.

specializations.title: Applying AI Where It Matters
specializations.description: I apply machine learning, NLP, and AI-driven techniques to real business problems, from analyzing customer feedback to building predictive models that support strategic decision-making.
